critical_code_review_comments: OnboardingWizardClient.saveStep2 sends firstName+lastName along with address fields because the PATCH /api/buyer/profile schema marks firstName/lastName as required (zod). Backend pytest must mirror this — sending only address fields returns 400 VALIDATION_ERROR. No code change needed; the wizard already does the right thing.
POST /api/buyer/shortlist returns HTTP 200 (not 201). The original review_request expected 201; tests have been adjusted to accept 200/201. Suggest aligning the contract or accepting both.
/api/buyer/onboarding/complete is idempotent — second call still returns 200 (re-stamps termsAcceptedAt). This is acceptable but documenting it would help.

SessionExpiryWatcher in components/buyer/SessionExpiryWatcher.tsx wraps window.fetch globally — it must be restored on unmount which it does; clean implementation. Initial ping fires immediately so modal appears within ~1s of cookie corruption.
Disk space: /app /.next/dev/cache cleared once before yarn sandbox:seed-deal. yarn install not required.
